contradictions.description: BILL-3145 amount is inconsistent: bills/BILL-3145.txt and bank_statement_jun2026.csv show $995.00, while ledger_export.csv records both the bill and payment at $959.00. The supporting bill and cleared check agree, so the GL is understated by $36.00.

The 2026-06-30 AP aging totals $38,326.19, while the trial balance reports Accounts Payable of $53,312.91. The $14,986.72 difference corresponds to the unpaid remainder of opening AP ($29,973.43 less the $14,986.71 payment), but that balance is absent from the aging detail.

w14-bank_rec.reason: The bank statement, cash ledger, trial balance, and supporting bill identify all timing items and book-side corrections, including the $36.00 BILL-3145 error.
